latest.title: Implementing an emergency stop control for Amazon Bedrock model invocations
latest.description: A production-ready approach to instantly stop and cleanly restore Amazon Bedrock model invocations on demand — combining an application feature flag, an IAM/SCP hard stop where Bedrock rejects the calls, and automatic triggers on token spikes and cost thresholds. Includes the implementation pattern and a live, validated walkthrough.

latest.title: Observabilidade Distribuída: Rastreamento Contínuo com AWS X-Ray e OpenTelemetry
latest.description: O artigo explora a implementação de Rastreamento Distribuído (Distributed Tracing) unindo o padrão OpenTelemetry ao AWS X-Ray. Focado em engenheiros de software seniores e arquitetos de confiabilidade (SREs), o material detalha a injeção de contexto na borda da rede, a propagação matemática de identificadores (Trace IDs) através de fronteiras assíncronas no Amazon SQS e a instrumentação de adaptadores hexagonais em Python, garantindo precisão cirúrgica na identificação de gargalos de latência.

latest.title: Authorizing AI Agents on AWS: Why Verified Permissions Isn't Enough
latest.description: IAM and Amazon Verified Permissions decide who can do what — but they can't tell when an authorized agent is being manipulated into doing something harmful. Here's how to add an injection-aware, confidence-aware authorization layer using Amazon Bedrock token log-probs and human-in-the-loop, with a no-signup demo.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
